messages:
nina-ml: Hey @eng-ml — ACME wants us to onboard `krypton-14b` into Private for a POC. They flagged p95 latency <120ms and said quantized variants (FP16 / INT8) are acceptable. Model tar: https://s3.company.com/clients/acme/krypton-14b.tar.gz

samir: Pinging quant team. Is there a target quality delta we should aim for? e.g., allowed BLEU/ROUGE drop or perplexity increase?

ashley: Also need a safety/evals baseline from product. Any toxic/regression concerns from the vendor?

ben: Quick arch question — is this standard GPT-like or custom (ALiBi / rope / other)? tokenizer quirks?

nina-ml: Vendor says GPT-like with rotary embeddings. They attached a tokenizer sample and 50 POC prompts — I'll upload to the ticket.

quantops-bot: New intake created: KT-215. Suggested pipeline: tokenizer sanity -> quant smoke -> perf bench -> regression evals. Estimated throughput: 3-4 days if infra is free.

samir: I'll take smoke quant. Request: please confirm the exact customer prompt set and whether to include chat-history context. Also, what's the fallback policy if quality regresses?

ashley: Recommend priority=high for POC. Fallback model: atlas-13b-v2 if krypton doesn't meet latency/quality.

runtime-oncall: We have a single 8xA100 slot free tomorrow 09:00 UTC. Please tag when ready to run.

nina-ml: Dropping a short intake checklist (will attach files):
- run tokenizer sanity on 1k prompts (check token counts + OOV)
- run FP16 smoke and GPTQ 4-bit smoke
- perf bench at seq=512 and seq=2048 (p50/p95 latency, throughput)
- run customer 50-prompt regression set and compare to vendor baseline
- generate per-layer quant error histograms and a quick qualitative eval

samir: For quant thresholds, start with per-layer L2 relative error. If any layer shows >2.5% jump vs FP16, flag for calibration or layer-wise retrain.

ben: Adding a quick model config to use in runtime tests:
```
model:
  name: krypton-14b
  dtype: fp16
  rotary: true
  max_seq: 2048
```

nina-ml: Assigned KT-215 -> samir (quant) + ben (runtime). @quantops-bot please create a canary route after smoke tests.

quantops-bot: Canary route created: `canary/krypton-14b/kt-215` (limit 10 rps). Dashboard: https://console.internal/reports/kt-215

ashley: :thumbsup: Setting intake tag to `customer-onboard-poc` and priority=high. Any blockers?

samir: I'll start smoke quant tomorrow at 09:30 UTC and upload logs to KT-215.

nina-ml: Perfect. I'll post prompt files and tokenizer sample to the ticket now — keeping thread for updates.
